newsitem.title: USA: Delta records $20.3 mln charge in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: Delta records $20.3 mln charge in Sept qtr.

text.p: Delta Air Lines said Wednesday it will record a $20.3 million non-operating charge for the settlement of a lawsuit with the American Society of Travel Agents in September.

The company did not provide a per share estimate for the charge, but said it expects to report strong revenue results for the September quarter, despite unit costs that were slightly higher than previous estimates.
The company said previous expectations of unit costs were $0.087 per available seat mile.
The company attributed the higher costs to increased jet fuel prices, higher technology development expenses and additional revenue-related expenses.
First Call estimates for Delta were not available.
